title: Japanese Market Ride-Hailing Platform
overview: A scalable, high-performance ride-hailing taxi platform tailored for the Japanese market, featuring native mobile apps for riders and drivers, sub-millisecond geospatial dispatch, and secure cloud infrastructure.

nodes.label: Riders & Drivers
nodes.purpose: End-users requesting, accepting, and completing taxi rides across Japan.

nodes.label: Platform Administrators
nodes.purpose: Operations staff monitoring fleets, managing user verifications, and configuring pricing.

nodes.label: Rider Mobile App
nodes.purpose: Native mobile application for passengers to request rides and track trips.

nodes.label: Driver Mobile App
nodes.purpose: Native mobile application for taxi operators to receive dispatch offers.

nodes.label: Admin Web Dashboard
nodes.purpose: Web-based portal for monitoring fleet operations and managing pricing rules.

nodes.label: API Gateway
nodes.purpose: Manage ingress traffic, TLS termination, and secure routing for clients.

nodes.label: Dispatch & Matching Service
nodes.purpose: Execute real-time spatial queries and algorithms to pair riders with drivers.

nodes.label: Pricing & Billing Service
nodes.purpose: Calculate dynamic fares and process payments via localized Japanese gateways.

nodes.label: Real-time Tracking Service
nodes.purpose: Handle high-frequency GPS coordinate streams and broadcast updates.

nodes.label: Transactional Database
nodes.purpose: Store user profiles, ride bookings, and transactional trip history with consistency.

nodes.label: Geospatial Cache
nodes.purpose: Deliver sub-millisecond in-memory operations for active driver location tracking.

nodes.label: Analytical Warehouse
nodes.purpose: Aggregate historical trip data for business intelligence and dynamic pricing.

nodes.label: Japanese Payment Gateway
nodes.purpose: Process secure in-app payments tailored to Japanese payment methods.

nodes.label: Container Orchestration
nodes.purpose: Run and autoscale containerized microservices across Japanese regions.

nodes.label: Messaging Backbone
nodes.purpose: Ingest high-throughput, asynchronous GPS updates and event streams.

nodes.label: IAM & Authorization
nodes.purpose: Enforce token-based authentication and principle of least privilege access.

nodes.label: Secret & Key Manager
nodes.purpose: Securely manage API keys, database credentials, and encryption keys.

nodes.label: Cloud Monitoring
nodes.purpose: Track infrastructure health, latency SLOs, and 99.99% uptime metrics.

requirement_mapping.requirement: Real-time location tracking and geo-spatial matching of riders and drivers
Dynamic pricing based on demand, traffic, and distance
Secure in-app payment processing tailored to Japanese payment methods
Low latency for real-time dispatch and GPS updates
Scalability to handle peak rush hours and large events
Robust security and data encryption for financial and personal location data

assumptions: Integration with local Japanese payment gateways will be required for seamless local transactions.
Mapping and navigation data will leverage standard commercial map APIs available in Japan.
GCP regions in Tokyo and Osaka provide sufficient compute and data redundancy.
Drivers frequently mount devices in orientations requiring robust responsive design.

technology_stack.purpose: Cross-platform native mobile apps for riders and drivers.
Admin web dashboard for platform operators.
High concurrency backend runtime for dispatch and tracking.
Globally distributed relational database for transactional consistency.
Massive-scale analytics and historical data warehousing.
Asynchronous event messaging backbone for GPS streams.
Secure storage for database credentials and API keys.
Tracking infrastructure health and 99.99% uptime SLOs.

security_considerations: Enforce TLS 1.3 for all data in transit across mobile applications and backend APIs.
Ensure complete data residency within Japanese GCP regions to comply with APPI regulations.
Store sensitive credentials and payment API keys securely using Secret Manager.
Apply fine-grained IAM least-privilege policies across all cloud resources.
scalability_considerations: Configure horizontal pod autoscaling on GKE to absorb sudden peaks during Tokyo rush hours.
Utilize Redis geospatial clustering to scale real-time driver proximity lookups.
Offload ephemeral high-frequency location writes to in-memory caches before batch-persisting.
Deploy multi-zone replication within Tokyo and Osaka regions for fault tolerance.
future_enhancements: AI-driven demand forecasting and predictive positioning for drivers.
Automated driver document verification using OCR and computer vision.
Expanded loyalty programs and corporate account management modules.
